LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneTheory.label: arcane theory
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneTheory.description: Study the first principles of mana, spell structure, and occult practice.
LanguageData.MFV_LeylineSensitivity.label: leyline sensitivity
LanguageData.MFV_LeylineSensitivity.description: Learn to perceive the subtle currents of mana that move through land, stone, and living things. Reveals hidden leylines on colony maps, helps gifted pawns recover mana faster near strong currents, and lets Arcane Forges resonate with nearby leyline power for a chance to improve enchanted weapon quality.
LanguageData.MFV_Lapidary.label: lapidary
LanguageData.MFV_Lapidary.description: Study the careful cutting and polishing of gemstones for trade, decoration, and magical craftsmanship.
LanguageData.MFV_Alchemy.label: alchemy
LanguageData.MFV_Alchemy.description: Refine plants, minerals, and reagents into magical compounds and restorative draughts.
LanguageData.MFV_Papyrus.label: papyrus
LanguageData.MFV_Papyrus.description: Study early sheet-making methods for preserving notes, formulae, and ritual observations.
LanguageData.MFV_Spellcraft.label: spellcraft
LanguageData.MFV_Spellcraft.description: Organize practical spellcasting into teachable schools of elemental, vital, shadow, and death magic.
LanguageData.MFV_ForbiddenLore.label: forbidden lore
LanguageData.MFV_ForbiddenLore.description: Record the first principles of magic that most traditions refuse to teach openly.
LanguageData.MFV_Elementalism.label: elementalism
LanguageData.MFV_Elementalism.description: Study the fundamental forces of nature and their magical manipulation.
LanguageData.MFV_Enchantment.label: enchantment
LanguageData.MFV_Enchantment.description: Bind persistent magical effects into tools, clothing, weapons, and ritual implements.
LanguageData.MFV_Summoning.label: summoning
LanguageData.MFV_Summoning.description: Study the art of calling forth and commanding otherworldly entities.
LanguageData.MFV_Transformation.label: transformation
LanguageData.MFV_Transformation.description: Study the art of changing one thing into another through magical means.
LanguageData.MFV_Illusion.label: illusion
LanguageData.MFV_Illusion.description: Study the art of creating deceptive images and sensory experiences through magical means.
LanguageData.MFV_Vitalism.label: vitalism
LanguageData.MFV_Vitalism.description: Work with growth, healing, resilience, and the magical rhythms of living bodies.
LanguageData.MFV_Parchmentry.label: parchmentry
LanguageData.MFV_Parchmentry.description: Develop durable prepared sheets for arcane notation, scrollwork, and practical magical records.
LanguageData.MFV_Pyromancy.label: pyromancy
LanguageData.MFV_Pyromancy.description: Study heat, combustion, and the deliberate shaping of magical flame.
LanguageData.MFV_Aquamancy.label: aquamancy
LanguageData.MFV_Aquamancy.description: Shape water into protective and hostile magic.
LanguageData.MFV_Aeromancy.label: aeromancy
LanguageData.MFV_Aeromancy.description: Harness pressure, wind, lightning, and sudden motion through disciplined spellcraft.
LanguageData.MFV_Geomancy.label: geomancy
LanguageData.MFV_Geomancy.description: Study stone, soil, metal, and the patient strength of the earth.
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneSecrets.label: arcane secrets
LanguageData.MFV_ArcaneSecrets.description: Unify several apprentice disciplines into deeper schools of colony-scale magic.
LanguageData.MFV_Necromancy.label: necromancy
LanguageData.MFV_Necromancy.description: Examine death, decay, lingering spirits, and the difficult border between body and soul.
LanguageData.MFV_Fleshcraft.label: fleshcraft
LanguageData.MFV_Fleshcraft.description: Alter living tissue through invasive magic, trading stability for power and survival.
LanguageData.MFV_Soulcraft.label: soulcraft
LanguageData.MFV_Soulcraft.description: Bind, preserve, wound, and strengthen souls through precise and dangerous rites.
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarMagic.label: planar magic
LanguageData.MFV_PlanarMagic.description: Reach beyond local space into other planes, hostile dimensions, and distant thresholds.
LanguageData.MFV_InfernalPact.label: infernal pact
LanguageData.MFV_InfernalPact.description: Study binding bargains, sacrificial power, and the summoning of infernal allies.
LanguageData.MFV_GrandSorcery.label: grand sorcery
LanguageData.MFV_GrandSorcery.description: Perform large rituals and endgame spells whose effects can reshape a whole colony.
LanguageData.MFV_Chronomancy.label: chronomancy
LanguageData.MFV_Chronomancy.description: Attempt the near-impossible discipline of stasis, acceleration, age, and altered time.
